template_data.lead_html: Eighteen months with an active GSA Schedule. Not a single federal dollar earned.

rows.what_html: SAM.gov becomes the daily brief — Sources Sought, presolicitations, agency spend history revealed three real NAICS matches
Two industry days, one teaming agreement — prime needed a certified sub on an upcoming recompete; signed within the week
First award. Then a second. — a CO found her on GSA Advantage after catalog cleanup; direct award, no competition

template_data.closer: THE SCHEDULE IS A DOOR. YOU STILL HAVE TO KNOCK.
